label: A6BC14D3_tP24_123_g2h_c_e2g2i_bg-001
title: High Temperature Bi$_{5}$PbTi$_{3}$O$_{14}$Cl Structure
comments:
This is the high temperature form of Bi$_{5}$PbTi$_{3}$O$_{14}$Cl, with data taken at 600$^{\circ}$. 
 Below 590$^{\circ}$ it transforms into the \href{current_web_home_dir/A6BC14D3_oP48_30_3c_a_7c_bc-001}{orthorhombic-temperature structure}. 
 The bismuth (4c) sites are actually 83.3\% bismuth and 16.7\% lead. 
 The \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/AFLOW_Prototype_Label}{AFLOW prototype label criterion} shifts the origin by $\frac12 c \hat{z}$, moving the Ti I atom from the (1a) to the (1b) site.
